title: Commuting amplification bridges
scientific_standard: PROVED denotes completed written derivation at named imports and internally checked scope; scripts and hashes do not independently certify mathematics, historical priority or physical advantage.

claims.statement: Original cubic general commuting repetition and fifth-power threshold bound.
claims.scope: Finite two-player Boolean games, arbitrary within-round question law, independent rounds, arbitrary joint commuting strategies.
claims.novelty_disposition: Prior capital; unchanged.

claims.scope: Bounded finite copied-input target in L2 of a finite von Neumann algebra, two normalized positive conditional comparisons of the same target, finite full and retained divergences, declared fine POVMs; actual all-input commuting witnesses. No uniform resource bound.

Standalone actual sampler Section 8 and pinned addenda
Explicit common amplification and local polar proof

claims.scope: Every finite exact nonnegative fractional rectangle partition, including overlap and nonintegral weights; keeps original conditional full fine table.
claims.novelty_disposition: Central new construction of this round; historical firstness not awarded.

claims.statement: Full charged finite-tracial FR(65536); sum t_i <= 3 log(1/p_D)+log(G_A G_B) <= 3 log(1/p_D)+2 sum_D kappa_i.
claims.scope: Positive tested event; arbitrary joint finite-tracial repeated strategy; independent coordinate question pairs; exact fractional presentations. G_A,c >= p_c, averaged G_A >= p_D, and Bob analogues.
claims.novelty_disposition: Closes the hypothesis explicitly left open in the earlier published paper. Old resolvent and separate history preparation are unnecessary.

claims.statement: Continuous actual-mass inverse-deficit scalar budget for arbitrary commuting correlation tables.
claims.scope: Fixed tested D with p_D>0; actual masses are representation-independent finite positive linear marginal-table functionals. No operational witness is passed through closure.
claims.novelty_disposition: New applicability/closure proof; finite tracial is not finite matrix.

claims.statement: omega_co(G^n) <= exp(-2^-75 epsilon_co^2 n) for all n>=1.
claims.scope: Every supported mask is a union of vertex-disjoint complete bipartite blocks; isolates allowed. Includes partial and noninjective projections; arbitrary joint questions per independent round; arbitrary joint commuting strategies.
claims.novelty_disposition: Main amplification strengthening. Unique-game restricted quadratic bounds already known; full novelty clearance not established.

claims.statement: omega_star(G^n) <= exp(-2^-75 epsilon_star^2 n) for all n>=1.
claims.scope: Same block predicate class, with its distinct tensor gap epsilon_star. All operations remain finite matrices before taking the tensor supremum.
dependencies: Finite-matrix instance of C and FR
claims.novelty_disposition: Distinct theorem, not substitution of a tensor gap into the commuting bound. Projection tensor predecessors recorded.

claims.statement: Quadratic gap power is optimal up to constants within the full disjoint-block class.
claims.scope: Original binary line games have epsilon_m=1/(2m-1) and commuting repeated value >= exp(-C epsilon_m^2 n) for n>=m^2, sufficiently large m. Does not establish optimal constants or total-projection optimality.
claims.novelty_disposition: Application of known lower bound; not a new line-game construction.

claims.statement: omega_co(G^n) <= exp(-2^-75 epsilon^3 n/(epsilon+kappa)); kappa <= 0.5 log min(|A|,|B|) is always available.
claims.scope: Fixed exact fractional presentation; arithmetic mean row/column loads define kappa. Zero-gap exponent interpreted as zero. Does not remove positive charge in general.
claims.novelty_disposition: Closes and refines prior charged application; logarithmic presentation improvement is not the claimed major discovery.

claims.statement: All wins <= exp(-2^-75 S/(1+C0)); weighted lower-loss tail <= exp(-2^-85 r^5 S/(1+C0)).
claims.scope: Independent possibly different games; kappa_i <= C0 epsilon_i; S=sum epsilon_i^2; Z=sum epsilon_i loss_i; 0<r<=1; tail Z<=(1-r)S. Full/zero tested sets handled.
claims.novelty_disposition: Prior conditional scalar consequences now have their FR premise proved; not a new scalar concentration method.

claims.scope: Finite game list; arbitrary probability weights r_i; exact exponent in dossier (7.1); all-input commuting capacity embedding.
dependencies: Labelled mixture and large sample allocation
claims.novelty_disposition: Elementary transfer; priority unclaimed.

claims.statement: Interactive noisy-channel acceptance bounded by inf_alpha exp((alpha-1)/alpha [log q0 + sum I_alpha(N_j)]), capped at one.
claims.scope: Ordinary finite-dimensional entangled protocols with question-independent initial resource, prescribed finite memoryless channel slots in either direction, arbitrary local adaptation, full accounting of controls/timing/routing. Same alpha for every term.
claims.novelty_disposition: New game-interface synthesis/application of established strong-converse machinery; no new channel capacity theorem.

claims.scope: Finite normalized cq source before legitimate input-copy delivery; comparison is prescribed question law tensor one question-independent resource. A hockey-stick operational defect has the separate outside e^h interface (8.4).
claims.novelty_disposition: Distinct source interfaces explicitly preserved; no general J_1-only tail bound.

claims.statement: Positive exponential soundness when aggregate entanglement-assisted capacity rate is strictly below certified zero-communication exponent g.
claims.scope: Fixed finite family of finite-dimensional memoryless channels; prescribed counts m_l(n)/n -> beta_l; independent inaccessible environments; no uncharged signals. Arbitrary n-dependent sources need a fixed-order margin.
dependencies: Continuity I_alpha -> C_E at order one
claims.novelty_disposition: Application of established continuity; feedback allowed only within charged interface.

claims.statement: Maximum-order transcript/CP domination for admissible commuting-start local instruments.
claims.scope: Explicit local Kraus/isometry coefficients in respective commuting algebras; prescribed channel interfaces; arbitrary abstract CP maps without local implementation excluded. No finite-order arbitrary-von-Neumann theorem claimed.
claims.novelty_disposition: Scope transfer of established mechanism.

claims.statement: Exact erasure-channel costs and exponent-matched polynomial randomized dense-coding/linear-code construction.
claims.scope: Guessing fixture, even n, 4n forward qubit erasure slots of survival 1/10; exponent 4 D_bin(1/8||1/10); upper and lower bounds differ only by 9/[32(4n+1)]. Costs: 4n EPR pairs/qubits, 8n^2 shared random bits, O(n^2) encoding and O(n^3) decoding. Logical simulation only.
claims.novelty_disposition: Established coding exponent credited. Strict gain over max-order/raw-dimension transfer demonstrated; no physical advantage claimed.

claims.statement: Inspected 2026 strict-CPTP hypotheses imply operator-norm convergence of iterated Petz recovery.
claims.scope: Counterexample is normal unital trace-preserving pair-mixing CP map on ell_infinity(N x {+,-}) with summable trace weights; norm difference remains one at all finite powers. Strong convergence survives; spectral gap repairs norm conclusion.
claims.novelty_disposition: Source-specific obstruction; not an objection to the positive-slack proof used here.

claims.statement: Bounded expected communication or Shannon leakage alone preserves exponential soundness.
claims.scope: Rare complete revelation of n bits with probability 1/n costs expected one bit and Shannon information ln2, yet success >=1/n.
claims.novelty_disposition: Obstruction test; requires finite-order/tail conditions instead.

claims.statement: General arbitrary-predicate quadratic commuting repetition.
claims.scope: Positive-presentation charge need not vanish with the game gap. Universal bounded-charge positive filtering is obstructed, not the semantic theorem itself.
claims.novelty_disposition: No unconditional general quadratic claim.

claims.statement: Unrestricted heterogeneous rate exp(-c sum epsilon_i^3/(epsilon_i+kappa_i)).
claims.scope: No bounded charge-to-gap ratio available; separate subgroup bounds cannot simply be multiplied.
claims.novelty_disposition: No claim of completion.

claims.statement: Polynomial-cost cryptographic compilation for growing repeated games.
claims.scope: Needs uniform controlled-degree/size/norm certificates and cryptographic costs. Finite-dimensional optimal strategy does not imply finite hierarchy convergence or flatness.
claims.novelty_disposition: Fixed-game literature is not a scalable compiler.
